title: Failure probability for monotone targets
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be monotone, let $t>0$ and $0<\varepsilon\le\tfrac12$ be rational, and suppose the total influence of $f$ is at most $t$. When the program is run on target $f$, the probability that its output hypothesis has relative Hamming distance strictly greater than $\varepsilon$ from $f$ is at most $1/10$.
hypotheses_covered: The target $f$ is a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The total influence of $f$ is at most $t$
